title: CHECKING DIMENSIONS
summary: Body checking dimensions (bolt-and-weld body structure, all models) at the windshield upper corners and the front roof center: section EE through the front roof center supports upper and lower (front of the T-top center bar), and two diagonal sections (FF, GG) through the windshield frame upper inner, the windshield upper outer-corner reinforcements and the hinge pillar (A-pillar) reinforcements. Measurement data only: no parts list or fasteners.

notes_internal: Body-in-white checking-dimension sheet (UPC 1 BOLT WELD): section cuts with dimensions from body reference lines; no callout list, no fasteners, no torques, empty revision block.

Dimensions table lists each section's printed values in reading order (top to bottom, left to right); which feature each value locates is only visible in the drawing. Reference lines copied as printed (circled grid numbers, SV/RV/WL, F.O.L./B.O.L. arrows).
FF-FF rightmost vertical dimension: last digit 6 or 8 (OCR 2:68); written 2.6?. Leftmost 2.56: first digit partly blotted but legible.
GG-GG: one horizontal dimension is printed '70' with no visible decimal point (probably .70); copied as printed.
Title block: drawing 3965172, L-82110, DR DP/C1, CK 4-30-69 C1, PREL 4-29-69, C/O C9, model 19000. 'K70' printed sideways at lower right.
